performance_case.causal_mechanism: A completed 3 percent BTC UTC-day shock may create a direction-conditioned next-24-hour continuation or reversal response, but only a delayed hash-bound evaluator frozen before eligible outcomes can distinguish that mechanism without horizon or direction selection after the fact.
performance_case.claim_boundary: A positive implementation result proves only that the closed schema, pure evaluator, immutable snapshots, heartbeat child and synthetic fixtures satisfy frozen local checks. It proves no real episode, prediction, significance, fees, slippage, PnL, drawdown, deployment, candidate, OOS or Trading value.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. A later spot-only matched-capital overlay might reduce adverse post-shock paths only if one terminal forward interpretation passes breadth and later economic/path-risk gates; all such value remains MISSING_PROOF.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: Implementing the already frozen evaluator now converts rare future shocks into one-shot evidence without waiting to write code after outcomes appear. The four-file cap prevents the diagnostic lane from expanding into a second framework, while strict breadth may deliberately delay or reject a weak effect.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: This slice has zero immediate fee-adjusted PnL effect. Its capability value is shortening the time from a future shock to an honest continuation, reversal or no-factor disposition while preserving equal-capital economic evaluation for a later separately preregistered experiment.
